13	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
14	 Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
15	the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
16	cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
17	Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
18	findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
19	Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
20	Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
21	The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
22	APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
23	The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
24	of the determination. 
25	Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
26	Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.  
27	Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
28	date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
29	Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
30	penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
31	IT IS SO ORDERED. 
32	HUSTON, BENNETT, FREEMAN, VELETA, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
33	APPROVED:

35	and correct copy of the Order as approved.

ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 Pursuant to India na Code chapte r 8 -1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”)  of 
the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excava tion damage 
cases and makes findings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee (“Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached  pages. 
The Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them 
of the determination. 
Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.  
Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
date of this Order unless o therwise agreed in writing by the Commission’s O ffice of General 
Counsel for good cause shown . Failure to complete the training r esults in the alternative civil 
penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED.
